risk_description:
The fuel hose may have been manufactured using a resin-based extrusion mandrel that was larger than design specification, thus it may have an improperly loose connection with the metal fuel hose connection pipe. 
As a result, fuel may leak at the joining point, increasing the risk of fire.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation  on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles
